image_description: A close-up shot of a white cardboard box for 'BAND-AID' brand adhesive bandages. The box features the red 'BAND-AID' logo at the top, followed by blue text and an illustration of two beige adhesive bandages with blue backing tabs. The packaging includes additional text in English and what appears to be Hebrew or similar script. The image focuses on the product packaging rather than a loose bandage.

The illustrated bandages on the box correctly depict the standard narrow rectangular shape with rounded corners.
